powertrains.transmission: Automatic transmission (ATF: Genuine NISSAN Matic P ATF)

maintenance_items.notes: Perform at number of miles, kilometers or months, whichever comes first.
If the oil replacement indicator is displayed, change engine oil and filter within two weeks or less than 500 miles (800 km). After replacing, reset the display.
Request dealer to inspect fluid deterioration data using CONSULT. If deterioration data is more than 77000, replace the AT fluid.
Replace more frequently when driving for prolonged periods in dusty conditions.
If operating mainly in dusty conditions, more frequent maintenance may be required.
Install new plugs of the type as originally equipped.
Recommended item (*). Check for wear, fraying or cracking and for proper tension. Replace any damaged drive belt.

First replacement at 105,000 miles (168,000 km) or 84 months. After first replacement, replace every 75,000 miles (120,000 km) or 60 months. Use Genuine NISSAN Long Life Antifreeze/Coolant (blue) or equivalent.
Recommended item (*). Inspect only if valve noise increases. Adjust valve clearance if necessary.
Recommended item (*). Check vapor lines for leaks or looseness.

fluids.specification: Genuine NISSAN Motor Oil 0W-20 SP (or equivalent). If not available, synthetic 0W-20 GF-6A SP motor oil may be used.
fluids.capacity: 6-3/8 qt with filter change; 5-7/8 qt without filter change

fluids.specification: Pre-diluted Genuine NISSAN Long Life Antifreeze/Coolant (blue) or equivalent. Provides antifreeze protection to −34°F (−37°C).
Genuine NISSAN Matic P ATF or equivalent. Do not mix with other fluids.
Genuine NISSAN Transfer Fluid LV or equivalent. Using transfer fluid other than Genuine NISSAN Transfer Fluid LV will damage the transfer.
Genuine NISSAN Differential Oil Hypoid Super GL-5 80W-90 or equivalent conventional (non-synthetic) oil
Genuine NISSAN HYPOID FLUID·S1 GL-5 75W-80 or equivalent
Genuine NISSAN Super Heavy Duty Brake Fluid or equivalent DOT 3

severe_conditions: Repeated short trips of less than 5 miles (8 km)
Repeated short trips of less than 10 miles (16 km) with outside temperatures remaining below freezing
Operating in hot weather in stop-and-go 'rush hour' traffic
Extensive idling and/or low speed driving for long distances, such as police, taxi or door-to-door delivery use
Driving on rough, muddy or salt spread roads
Towing a trailer, using a camper or car-top carrier
oil_life_monitor: An oil replacement indicator is displayed when an oil change is due. If the indicator is displayed, change the engine oil and filter within two weeks or less than 500 miles (800 km). After replacing the engine oil, reset the display.
extraction_caveats: 1. The maintenance schedule covers the VR35DDTT engine only, as that is the sole engine model listed in the provided pages. 2. Recurring items were identified by analyzing all mileage columns and reporting the repeat interval rather than each individual occurrence. 3. Engine valve clearance and evaporative emissions control vapor lines are described in the explanations section but no specific mileage/time interval is given in the provided pages — interval_miles and interval_months are set to null. 4. The 'Intelligent Key battery' appears as 'inspect' at 15,000-mile intervals and 'replace' at 30,000-mile intervals (first replace at 30,000 mi/36 mo, then every 30,000 mi/36 mo); both actions are captured separately. 5. Engine drive belt inspection first appears at 60,000 miles/72 months and recurs every 10,000 miles/12 months thereafter per the schedule pages. 6. Engine coolant first replacement is at 105,000 miles/84 months; subsequent interval is 75,000 miles/60 months per footnote on page 592. 7. Fuel tank vapor vent system and fuel lines/connections are recommended (*) items appearing at 20,000-mile intervals. 8. Page 426 (Steering Assist) and index pages (640–643) contain no maintenance schedule data and were not used for extraction.
corrections: Engine drive belt: interval_miles 60000 -> 10000, first_at_miles null -> 60000, first_at_months null -> 72; the item first appears at 60,000 mi/72 mo then repeats every 10,000 mi/12 mo (pages 587-593 show it at 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 100k, 110k, 120k)
Engine coolant: interval_miles 105000 -> 75000, interval_months 84 -> 60; the first_at values were already correct at 105000/84, but the repeat interval is 75,000 mi/60 mo per footnote on page 592
